basis: A08 bounded closure in ongoing supportable pass; all other rows and12 external requirements preserved. Availability reassessment is separate.

definitionRepresentationRequirements.specificUnresolvedRequirement: Define metal identity/oxidation, donor state and coordination context; zinc-binding motif is not established coordination.
definitionRepresentationRequirements.existingImplementation: OCL matcher can express motifs; no qualified classifier
definitionRepresentationRequirements.scopeLimitation: Zinc-binding motif identity must name the exact donor states/coordination context. Existing donor/acceptor identities are not metal ligation assertions; no element-only metal-binding label.

definitionRepresentationRequirements.specificUnresolvedRequirement: Define weak C-H donor classes, attachment/acidity scope and independent geometric controls.
definitionRepresentationRequirements.scopeLimitation: Exact weak C-H donor class scope and directionality/window remain distinct from ordinary donor roles. Methyl identity and raw POINT_PAIR_GROUP geometry are implemented; no universal favorable C-H interaction follows from C/H elements.

definitionRepresentationRequirements.specificUnresolvedRequirement: Define aromatic-face acceptance, halogen axis and element-specific geometry separately from atom-acceptor rules.
definitionRepresentationRequirements.support: RING4 primary paper non-covalent bond section
definitionRepresentationRequirements.scopeLimitation: Aromatic-face halogen interaction requires explicit face/axis/angular/radius definition separate from atom-acceptor I10; ring and mixed geometry exist. Do not silently substitute atom distance thresholds.

definitionRepresentationRequirements.specificUnresolvedRequirement: Specify coordination number/geometry, ligand typing, waters and complete candidate sphere.
definitionRepresentationRequirements.scopeLimitation: Coordination number/geometry requires complete candidate sphere, donor/water typing, treatment of competing geometries and metal state. Generic centroid/angle machinery is available; no universal coordination template is selected.

definitionRepresentationRequirements.specificUnresolvedRequirement: Select radii/H/bond/altloc/water protocol and justified overlap classes; I16 gap alone is not a clash criterion.
definitionRepresentationRequirements.support: Probe source; MolProbity clashes; wwPDB guide
definitionRepresentationRequirements.scopeLimitation: I16 retains attributed continuous surface gaps. A serious-clash class needs the exact radii/H/bond-exclusion/altloc/water protocol and empirical validation; Probe 0.4 A belongs to its own protocol, not all radius models.

definitionRepresentationRequirements.specificUnresolvedRequirement: Review query/dummy/enhanced-stereo representability and validation scope separately from molecular truth.
definitionRepresentationRequirements.existingImplementation: Graph mapper and sanitizer; unresolved mapping retained
definitionRepresentationRequirements.scopeLimitation: OclGraphMapper supports specific atom parity strings and rejects unsupported bond stereo; MolecularGraph has no reviewed query-atom/dummy/enhanced-stereo-group semantics. Generic properties can preserve unknown assertions but do not execute them. Need exact additive opt-in representation/operation contract before new property semantics; do not silently cast a query molecule as a physical one.

definitionRepresentationRequirements.capability: Composition, missing atoms, alternate conformations, occupancy/B factors, linkage
definitionRepresentationRequirements.specificUnresolvedRequirement: Review missing-atom/composition/altloc/occupancy/linkage propositions and uncertainty propagation per source format.
definitionRepresentationRequirements.scopeLimitation: Expected composition/missing-atom assertion requires an external expected-component/topology model; occupancy/altloc/linkage scopes are format-dependent. Preserve source metadata, distinguish absent field from zero, and specify conflict/evaluation policy before classifying incompleteness.

definitionRepresentationRequirements.capability: Chemical alerts and substructure filter catalogs
definitionRepresentationRequirements.specificUnresolvedRequirement: Review specific alert catalog/version/domain and advisory semantics; never automatic evidence rejection.
definitionRepresentationRequirements.existingImplementation: Existing matcher; no qualification of these catalogs
definitionRepresentationRequirements.scopeLimitation: Pinned OCL contains890 embedded PAINS entries. Exact encoded-query to SMARTS roundtrip demonstrated for386, not established for504; B00 accepts886 generated queries and explicitly rejects4. Existing PainsDetector bypasses B00 and returns labels without Athena atom mappings. Need qualified lossless transfer/domain/fixtures plus advisory meaning; do not equate catalog membership with toxicity or automatic rejection.

definitionRepresentationRequirements.specificUnresolvedRequirement: Review sulfur state-specific thioether/thiol/thiolate/disulfide/sulfonium and pi/O partner domains independently.
definitionRepresentationRequirements.support: Attached advanced-rule request; existing Athena sources; no external parity asserted
definitionRepresentationRequirements.scopeLimitation: Existing thioether/thiol/thiolate/disulfide source distinctions and raw geometry do not establish one sulfur-pi/chalcogen class. Methionine survey is not cysteine evidence; each sulfur state/partner/geometry domain requires its own supported criterion.

definitionRepresentationRequirements.specificUnresolvedRequirement: Review SAM/SAH identity and sulfonium/methyl/aromatic domains; no ammonium-pi parameter transplant.
definitionRepresentationRequirements.support: Attached advanced-rule request; existing Athena sources; no external parity asserted
definitionRepresentationRequirements.scopeLimitation: Source SAM/SAH identity and sulfonium/methyl/aromatic orientation must remain separate. Existing graph/groups/geometry can preserve selected measurements; no universal SAM-aromatic window or ammonium-to-sulfonium transfer is justified.

definitionRepresentationRequirements.specificUnresolvedRequirement: Review selected nucleophile/SAM state and substrate-specific transfer geometry; linearity is not reactivity.
definitionRepresentationRequirements.support: Attached advanced-rule request; existing Athena sources; no external parity asserted
definitionRepresentationRequirements.scopeLimitation: Raw selected donor-methyl/nucleophile distances and approach angles are supported. General SAM/substrate identity and reaction-competent windows require exact state/role definitions; no catalysis inferred from a linear tuple.

externalReferenceDataRequirements.specificUnresolvedRequirement: Select chemical-context reference lengths/angles, uncertainty and outlier definition.
externalReferenceDataRequirements.existingImplementation: Geometry primitives; no qualified reference-distribution validator found
externalReferenceDataRequirements.scopeLimitation: Pinned wwPDB guide specifies comparison to reference means/sigmas; neither a complete reviewed CCD/monomer release nor all context-dependent uncertainty tables are bundled. Need release/accession, atom/bond/state mapping, units, target and sigma, applicability and redistribution license. Existing raw distances/angles are implemented; no universal sigma is valid.

externalReferenceDataRequirements.specificUnresolvedRequirement: Define coordinate stereo/planarity comparison against supplied chemistry and qualified reference domain.
externalReferenceDataRequirements.existingImplementation: Graph stereo checks only; no full coordinate validator qualified
externalReferenceDataRequirements.scopeLimitation: Raw plane diagnostics exist. Arbitrary atom ordering cannot establish chiral sign, and wwPDB sidechain planarity uses precomputed reference deviations. Need pinned component stereochemical ordering, expected configurations, group membership, normalization and applicable reference deviations. Guide thresholds alone do not supply these references.

externalReferenceDataRequirements.specificUnresolvedRequirement: Review exact Ramachandran grid release, license, interpolation and residue/peptide classes.
externalReferenceDataRequirements.existingImplementation: No qualified equivalent found in inspected rule surfaces
externalReferenceDataRequirements.scopeLimitation: Need pinned actual grid release (not README), license/redistribution terms, residue/peptide classes, axes/binning/periodicity, density values, interpolation and outlier interpretation. Older restraint tables are not a substitute.

externalReferenceDataRequirements.specificUnresolvedRequirement: Review rotamer reference grid, symmetry, interpolation and complete chi/altloc coverage.
externalReferenceDataRequirements.existingImplementation: No qualified protein rotamer validator in registry
externalReferenceDataRequirements.support: MolProbity rotamer guide; OCL TorsionDB inventory
externalReferenceDataRequirements.scopeLimitation: Need exact multidimensional chi grids, residue/protonation/altloc class membership, symmetry/periodicity, interpolation, normalization and release/license. Pinned cctbx 0.003/0.02 use that distribution; constants alone are insufficient.

externalReferenceDataRequirements.specificUnresolvedRequirement: Review idealization algorithm/parameters and modified/D-residue domain before classifying C-beta deviation.
externalReferenceDataRequirements.scopeLimitation: Pinned cbetadev algorithm exists; complete ideal geometry/monomer parameter closure and residue/D/modified-residue applicability are not bundled/qualified. Need immutable release/license and parameter files; do not substitute a generic ideal C-beta.

externalReferenceDataRequirements.specificUnresolvedRequirement: Review CaBLAM empirical contours, dimensionality and complete backbone selection.
externalReferenceDataRequirements.scopeLimitation: Need exact contour release, high-dimensional axes, residue/secondary-structure applicability, interpolation and thresholds plus license. Raw backbone dihedrals cannot reproduce empirical probability contours.

externalReferenceDataRequirements.capability: RNA sugar pucker and backbone suite validation
externalReferenceDataRequirements.specificUnresolvedRequirement: Review RNA atom/topology domains and pucker/suite reference distributions.
externalReferenceDataRequirements.scopeLimitation: Need exact Richardson/wwPDB suite/pucker reference release, conformer definitions, atom names-to-authoritative-graph correspondence, periodic angle/suite rules, exclusions and license. Generic torsion measurements are not RNA validation.

externalReferenceDataRequirements.specificUnresolvedRequirement: Establish licensed empirical ligand geometry distributions and sample coverage; no generic substitute.
externalReferenceDataRequirements.scopeLimitation: Need authorized versioned distributions, fragment/state matching rules, sample counts/exclusions and outlier definition; redistribution/access license required. No generic bond geometry substitutes for Mogul empirical data.

externalReferenceDataRequirements.specificUnresolvedRequirement: Define external diffraction/refinement report ingestion and data provenance; coordinates alone insufficient.
externalReferenceDataRequirements.scopeLimitation: Need structure factors or intensities with uncertainties, R-free flags, unit cell/space group, resolution/selection, refinement protocol/model correspondence and data accession/license. Source report ingestion separately qualified; no native metric computed.

externalReferenceDataRequirements.specificUnresolvedRequirement: Define experimental map/state alignment and map-model metric domain.
externalReferenceDataRequirements.existingImplementation: Evidence can preserve reports; evaluator absent
externalReferenceDataRequirements.scopeLimitation: Need map coefficients/grid, origin/sampling, frame/model binding, resolution/selection, metric definition and accession/license. Coordinates alone do not establish density fit. Report ingestion separately qualified.

externalReferenceDataRequirements.specificUnresolvedRequirement: Define experimental shifts/restraints and ensemble correspondence; coordinate agreement is not experimental validation.
externalReferenceDataRequirements.existingImplementation: Evidence storage supports opaque reports; no evaluator
externalReferenceDataRequirements.scopeLimitation: Need units, ambiguity/assignment policy, experimental accession/license and ensemble/model correspondence; individual restraints and unavailable observations retained. Report ingestion separately qualified.

externalReferenceDataRequirements.capability: EM map validation and map-model fit
externalReferenceDataRequirements.specificUnresolvedRequirement: Define map-only vs model-fit criteria, resolutions/masks and source provenance.
externalReferenceDataRequirements.scopeLimitation: Need grid/origin/sampling/alignment, map-only versus model-fit metric, halfmaps and masks where required, resolution/protocol and accession/license. Report ingestion separately qualified.
